numbering.samples_why: its atoms are the latest in the ledger (indices 3418 to 3424), so a quantity's token code is about 10,240 and each generated object codes to a number of about 200,000 bits; 20 generated objects witness the six conditions in about 8 s where 120 take 40 s (the decoding is by p-adic valuation already). The root fix is a per-set dense rank for positional codes, which amends the numbering GM-4 states and is the user's call (docs/GODEL_AUDIT.md).

statement: Physical dimension as content: the SI base quantities are atoms, a dimension is a signed content vector over them (acceleration is length*time^-2), and an equation is dimensionally consistent exactly when its two sides have one content. The IR's ops act on dimensions through the model stated here, a second algebra of the signature whose carrier is the content group; their numeric meaning stays the op cards' (FOUNDATIONS A2, D14).
